title: Q-YEAR-SIM-cloudflare-incident: its recovery is declared but no drill exercises code
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** the year simulation (YEAR-SIM-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe cloudflare-incident
**Status:** closed

Fault class `cloudflare-incident`: its recovery is declared but no drill exercises code. Drill evidence: Cloudflare-hosted loops and deploys pause; claude-routine, github-actions keeps the checks and merges going (declared)

Build the mechanism that recovers from it without a person, then the drill in foundation/yearsim.py must exercise it.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe cloudflare-incident` exits 0.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-22T01:33:12Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
